Step: 1643 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100, not by 400).  
95 days from 1643-12-10:  
December has 31 days → 21 days left in Dec → 95 - 21 = 74 days left.  
January 1644 has 31 days → 74 - 31 = 43 days left.  
February 1644 is leap year? 1644 divisible by 4, not by 100 → leap year → 29 days → 43 - 29 = 14 days left.  
March 1644 → 14 days into March = March 14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1644-03-14
